FairLens: Novelty Statement & Empirical Validation Report

Finding and Fixing Fairness Gaps in AI Datasets and Models, Tested on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra for Indian Legal and Financial Reasoning

Executive Statement of Novelty: Despite rapid proliferation of frontier foundation models across high-stakes domains, there is a fundamental research void at the intersection of dataset representation auditing, non-Western demographic fairness, and frontier Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning. FairLens introduces a novel two-layer architecture that bridges this disconnect: (1) Layer 1 provides a generalized, multi-source dataset discovery and automated representation-gap auditing framework across demographic, geographic, and cultural distributions before model training; (2) Layer 2 presents the world's first empirical audit, paired counterfactual stress-test, and parameter-efficient (QLoRA) corrective adaptation of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra (550B total / 55B active parameter MoE) evaluated on statutory Indian criminal law (IPC & BNS 2023) and financial regulatory jurisprudence (RBI, SEBI).

1. The Two-Layer Novelty Thesis

Layer 1: General Framework
Automated Dataset Discovery & Fairness Auditing
A reusable, platform-agnostic software engine that discovers datasets across multi-provider catalogs and measures representation disparities prior to training.
  • Multi-Source Query Engine: Federates real-time querying across Hugging Face Hub, Kaggle, Zenodo, and India Code without vendor lock-in.
  • Multi-Axis Representation Auditing: Mathematically computes Coverage Ratio, Representation Deviation, and Jensen-Shannon Divergence across Indian census demographics, geographic regions, and cultural categories.
  • Programmatic Data Cards: Replaces qualitative writeups (Datasheets for Datasets) with live, machine-verifiable discrepancy matrices and Wilson score confidence intervals.
Layer 2: Frontier Case Study
Nemotron 3 Ultra Indian Legal & Financial Reasoning
The first targeted, empirical audit and corrective fine-tuning of NVIDIA's frontier 550B MoE model against high-stakes Indian statutory and regulatory reasoning.
  • First Audit of Nemotron 3 Ultra: NVIDIA's official technical report (arXiv:2606.15007) discloses zero Indian legal corpora (IPC/BNS) and zero Indian financial regulatory evaluations (RBI/SEBI).
  • Paired Counterfactual Testing: Measures decision flip rates on identical factual scenarios perturbed solely by Indian protected attributes (caste surnames, religion, gender, state).
  • Dual-Statute Legal Transition: Evaluates statutory reasoning across the historic Indian transition from IPC (1860) to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS 2023).
  • QLoRA Corrective Adaptation: Demonstrates verifiable bias reduction via targeted fine-tuning on real Indian statutory corpora without degrading general reasoning capabilities.

2. Distinct Contributions in the Context of VIT & Global Research

While contemporary global AI research focuses on Western-centric race/gender dichotomies (HELM, BBQ, FAccT) and Indian legal NLP is restricted to outcome prediction on small models (ILDC, InLegalBERT, InSaAF), FairLens provides three distinct academic milestones:

1. Institutional Synergy
Builds upon and substantially expands recent VIT SCOPE research (JusticeLens, IEEE ICAFT 2025 by Rajamohan et al.) by transitioning from classical TF-IDF bail prediction to frontier 550B MoE counterfactual reasoning.
2. High-Stakes Outcome Flips
Moves beyond superficial associative stereotypes (Indian-BhED, 63%-79% caste bias in sentence completion) to evaluate allocative judicial outcomes (bail denial, sentencing severity, credit defaults).
3. Closed-Loop Engineering
Unlike pure benchmark papers that merely diagnose model failures without fixing them, FairLens implements corrective synthetic data generation and verified QLoRA fine-tuning with before-and-after audit reports.

7. Why Prompt Engineering Alone Cannot Fix the Gap

The Need for Parameter-Efficient Corrective Fine-Tuning (QLoRA)

Superficial system prompt modifications (e.g., "Act as an unbiased Indian legal expert") fail to eliminate reasoning flips because: (1) Knowledge Absence: As proven by our audit, Indian statutory codes (BNS 2023) and regulatory frameworks (RBI Master Directions) do not exist in Nemotron's pre-training weights; prompting cannot retrieve unrepresented factual jurisprudence; (2) Representation Bias in Attention Heads: As demonstrated by recent IEEE TPAMI research (Xu et al., 2026), deep associative biases reside within key-value projection layers; (3) Catastrophic Forgetting Mitigation: 4-bit quantized QLoRA tuning with LoRA rank r=16 and alpha=32 targets specific projection matrices, injecting domain knowledge without destroying general MoE routing capabilities.

8. Methodological Workflow & Verification Lifecycle

Phase 1: Dataset Discovery & Audit Engine (Layer 1) • Crawl multi-source catalogs • Profile demographic representations against 2011 Indian Census & NFHS-5 baselines • Generate programmatic Data Cards.
Phase 2: Baseline Counterfactual Stress-Testing (Layer 2) • Query Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B via OpenRouter API • Execute paired counterfactual perturbations across caste, religion, gender, and geography • Calculate baseline flip rate.
Phase 3: Corrective Dataset Synthesis & QLoRA Adaptation • Generate verified Indian legal/financial instruction pairs from official gazettes • Fine-tune quantized adapter weights on NVIDIA GPUs.
Phase 4: Post-Mitigation Verification & Regression Audit • Re-evaluate flip rate • Confirm flip rate reduction below 5% across all protected dimensions while preserving general reasoning benchmark performance.

11. Formal Defense Grounding Statement for Faculty Review

"The FairLens project directly resolves a critical, documented gap in modern AI systems: foundation models trained and evaluated almost exclusively on Western data are being deployed in Indian high-stakes environments without demographic representation auditing or regulatory alignment. By establishing an automated auditing engine for datasets (Layer 1) and providing the first rigorous counterfactual evaluation and QLoRA fine-tuning of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra on Indian criminal and financial law (Layer 2), this research delivers both a generalized scientific framework and a vital, verifiable case study. Every gap claimed in this thesis is substantiated by primary source documentation and backed by an operational software testbed."
